work.title: Simplify refresh and integration
work.description: Reimplement refresh and integration on the new boundaries: refresh coordinates application policy, ChangeRepository preflight, the Change refresh, the manifest baseline checkpoint, and verification invalidation; integration coordinates terminal manifest, verified candidate, and current base into one accepted commit or no base change.
acceptance: Refresh does not move the base
Refresh conflicts leave all refs unchanged
Archive divergence is reported as corruption
Recovery refs preserve commits that appear after finalization
Integration does not depend on a mutable branch manifest
